evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage cards (spring-festival, dragon-boat, paper-cutting, peking-opera, kunqu-opera, chinese-calligraphy, suzhou-embroidery, yixing-teapot) matching the displayed count "共 8 个非遗项目".
Each card (e.g. 春节) shows title (春节), brief description paragraph, region (北京 · 华夏大地), and category (民俗活动).
All 8 items use categories 民俗活动(folk), 传统美术(art), 传统表演(performance), 传统工艺(craft) which map to the 4 supported categories in the filter dropdown.

Search "京剧" narrowed list to 1 item with count "共 1 个非遗项目". Category filter "传统工艺" narrowed to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) with count updating. Sort by name/year/region each produced distinctly different, correctly ordered item sequences (region sort alphabetical by province: 安徽,北京,北京,广东,江苏×3,陕西).

Clicking thumb 1 shows main image alt="苏绣 - 1"; clicking thumb 2 (a purposely broken image) replaces main image with explicit failure state "图片加载失败" plus icon, and the thumb itself shows a broken-image placeholder; clicking thumb 3 correctly restores main image to "苏绣 - 3".
Detail page for 苏绣 shows title (苏绣), category (传统工艺), region (江苏 · 江南水乡), inclusion year (2006年入选), full description paragraph, and a gallery with 3 selectable images/thumbnails.
Set category filter=传统工艺 and sort=按地区 on homepage, opened 苏绣 detail page, navigated back: filters still show category=传统工艺, sort=按地区, and grid still shows the filtered 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂).
From detail page for 苏绣, clicking "浏览更多项目" navigated to http://localhost:6063/#categories and the project list (listing.grid) is visible with the previously filtered items.

Valid link /heritage/suzhou-embroidery correctly opened the matching 苏绣 detail page. Invalid URL /heritage/nonexistent-item-xyz shows only a not-found state with a "返回首页" link back to homepage and no unrelated project details rendered.

Clicking the 苏绣 hotspot opened an overlay with image "苏绣", category (传统工艺), title (苏绣), region (江苏 · 江南水乡), brief description paragraph, and a "查看详情" link (href=/heritage/suzhou-embroidery) to view full details.

issue: Drag-to-rotate does not reliably respond to real drag gestures
actual: Zooming in/out correctly changes visible hotspot subset without permanent loss (zoom in reduced from 4 to 2 visible hotspots, zoom out restored all 4). However, repeated real (CDP-trusted) drag gestures on the panorama drag surface ([data-semtag-id='panorama.hotspots']) with substantial horizontal distance, in both directions, across a fresh page load and multiple attempts (6 of 7 clean attempts), produced NO change to the panorama transform (translateX stayed at 0px) or hotspot layout. Only one anomalous attempt (immediately following other interactions, likely a state artifact) produced a small rotation. A full 360° rotation via drag could not be reliably achieved, so the "rotate and continue interacting with hotspots as the view wraps around" behavior could not be verified as working.

evidence: Zoomed panorama to scale(1.4) (narrowing visible hotspots to suzhou-embroidery, peking-opera), opened the suzhou-embroidery hotspot overlay, clicked "查看详情" to go to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery, then navigated back: the panorama returned with scale(1.4) still applied and the same 2 hotspots (suzhou-embroidery, peking-opera) visible, matching the pre-navigation state.

Each heritage item is assigned a unique, distinct image URL (e.g. 春节→photo-1513519245088, 端午龙舟→photo-1547981609, 剪纸→photo-1582719508461, 京剧→photo-1518611012118, 昆曲→photo-1507003211169, 书法→photo-1455390582262, 苏绣→photo-1578662996442, 宜兴紫砂→photo-1544787219) with alt text matching the item's name across homepage cards, panorama overlay, and detail-page gallery, with no unrelated image reused across different items. Actual photographic subject-matter accuracy could not be verified since visual/screenshot inspection is disallowed by testing constraints; verification is based on DOM-level naming/id consistency.
